name: Aroon the Urlamhai

facts.text: Level 81, 300,000 health. The first time he fights he summons nine Scaith, one for each damage type: Corp, Spiorad, Ropadh, Damhna, Fuinneamg, Bru, Fuar, Taes and Scor.
Each Scaith's eyes glow 'indicating he's being controlled by Aroon', and now and then it drops its foe for a random player. He roots everything within 1,200.
In the original fight each damage type hurt Aroon only after its matching Scaith died; for Living Server raids that order is behind a switch.

Scaith glosses (Irish, to verify): scáth 'shadow'; corp body, spiorad spirit, fuar cold, teas heat, damhna matter, fuinneamh energy, brú crush, ropadh stab, scor cut. 'Urlamhai' may echo urlámhas, 'control'.

story: Aroon was a guardian of the old forest, a tree-lord of the kind the Sylvan call a keeper, and the Root took him slowly, the way rot takes heartwood. What is left keeps nothing but himself. He learned in the hollow how a thing may be made very hard to kill: he cut his own nine weaknesses out of himself and gave each a shadow to carry. One holds the blade's edge, one the spear's point, one the hammer's weight; one holds cold, one heat, one the spirit and one the body; one holds the stuff of the world and one its energy. The nine stand round him with his own light in their eyes and turn on whoever he points at. The Sylvan say the name means one who holds sway. He holds it by holding the ground: when he speaks, roots rise and nobody near him moves.
legend: Nine shadows, nine kinds of harm. The old guides said each Scaith had to die before its kind of damage would touch him, and veterans still kill them first out of habit: they hit hard and swap targets. Tanks pick up the Scaith that wander off. Expect the whole room rooted when he roots. Do not drag him away from his hall.

aggro: Come, my shadows. Each of you knows a way to kill.

phases.text: Nine wounds I gave away. Nine shadows keep them.
You have learned my weaknesses. I have more.

death: The shadows... give back what they kept.

lairEntry: Nine shadows stand where none were cast.

phases.text: Aroon summons the Scaith to do his bidding!

loremasterTopic.text: A keeper of the old forest, rotted from within. He cut his nine weaknesses out and gave each to a shadow, a Scaith, to carry. Kill the shadows and you take back the ways to wound him.

bookPage: The Sylvan word for a keeper-tree is not one I can spell, but the one they used for Aroon was simpler: they called him the one who gave his wounds away. A tree may be cut, burned, crushed, frozen or rotted. Aroon would be none of these, so he made nine servants and gave each a way he might die. I asked what happens when a servant dies. The old one smiled. Then the wound comes home, she said.
